endorsements.quote: Finally, clinicians must continue to maintain accountability for documentation accuracy and completeness, which entails reviewing, approving, and signing off on AI-drafted notes before they become part of the medical record.

A “trust but verify” posture is essential—AI outputs must be reviewed by a qualified clinician before influencing clinical decisions, and formal AI governance processes should provide ongoing oversight with a lens toward patient safety and equity.

AI-generated draft responses and summaries must be reviewed and edited by the clinician before use; and provider training should cover not only how to use these tools but how to critically evaluate their outputs.

Technology decisions should never be made by administrators without meaningful input from the clinicians who will use the tools and the patients who will be affected by them.
Organizations should require that vendors communicate meaningful model changes proactively and provide mechanisms for clinical re-validation before updated versions are deployed in care settings.

unlisted_practices: Make ambient listening tools strictly opt-in, requiring patients to affirmatively consent before any encounter is recorded.
Ensure ambient AI data handling conforms to the highest HIPAA-compliance standards.
Establish baseline values for outcome indicators before AI deployment, define intervention threshold criteria, and conduct structured review cycles, ideally quarterly.
Measure AI's impact on communication quality, patient trust, and provider well-being rather than only financial metrics and general satisfaction scores.
Involve Patient and Family Advisory Councils on an ongoing basis to evaluate how AI integration affects the care experience.
Commit explicitly to protect the relational time AI creates, using policy guardrails, scheduling constraints, or performance metrics that reward relationship quality over throughput.
Include key clinical constituencies on AI evaluation committees and in vendor selection and use-case prioritization.
Establish mechanisms for providers to give feedback before, during, and after AI deployment to enable continuous optimization.
Select AI vendors that demonstrate flexibility and collaborative co-development rather than rigid off-the-shelf solutions.
